name: Flood Hover
description: An image card whose overlay floods in from the side the pointer entered and drains toward the side it leaves.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown on the sheet, laid out as a column at the bottom. Text inherits a light colour in both themes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card. Give it a size or an aspect ratio; it has no height of its own.
